name: Uriel
overview: The name Uriel appears in Scripture primarily as a Levite, specifically a son of Tahath, indicating his priestly lineage (1 Chronicles 6:24). He is also noted as a chief among the sons of Kohath who played a significant role in assisting the Levites in bringing the ark of the covenant to its designated place under King David's direction (1 Chronicles 15:5, 11-12). Additionally, Uriel is identified as the grandfather of King Abijah through his daughter Michaiah, linking him to the royal line of Judah (2 Chronicles 13:2). These references highlight Uriel’s important contributions both in worship and in the heritage of Israel’s kings.
